query_criteria.a8-temporal-01: Requires an explicit fiscal/external-balance channel to rupee pressure. A generic oil/rupee association, forecast or intervention account is insufficient.
query_criteria.a8-temporal-02: Requires an explicit tanker-freight cost mechanism, such as insurance or rerouting. Attacks, commodity prices or domestic goods freight without that linkage are not answers.
query_criteria.a8-temporal-03: Requires the February Indian headline/rural/urban release readings. Food-only figures, forecasts, other-country CPI and IIP are not that measure.
query_criteria.a8-temporal-04: Accepts explicit Indian oil/inflation/fiscal or bond-supply drivers as partial explanations. Other-country yields, level-only observations and deposit-rate transmission do not answer the government-bond question.
query_criteria.a8-temporal-05: Requires oil-price or dollar-flow changes for the 13 April decline. Earlier episodes, policy history and same-day blockade detail without a price/flow change do not supply that answer.
query_criteria.a8-temporal-06: Requires the RBI outlook reported on 8 April. Other analysts, earlier expectations, FX-market commentary and a heading without the changed outlook are insufficient.
query_criteria.a8-temporal-07: Requires the April PMI survey input-cost drivers. The actual survey quote explicitly attributes spillovers to the conflict; separate surveys, general margin forecasts and manufacturing demand readings are insufficient.
query_criteria.a8-temporal-08: Accepts explicit Indian international-carrier airspace/rerouting fuel burdens and international ATF-cost treatment as partial explanations. Generic oil/gas supply background is insufficient.
query_criteria.a8-temporal-09: Requires evidence of the late-May corporate currency/cost burden or extended hedging response. Earlier generic market or logistics developments and unrelated US-carrier margins do not identify that episode.
query_criteria.a8-temporal-10: Accepts explicit June FCNR/deposit/swap incentives or the identified package expected inflow and currency effects. Generic unspecified expectations, historical pressure and older policy are insufficient.
query_criteria.a8-temporal-11: Accepts weather/rainfall effects on Indian crop output, food supply/prices and reservoir/soil-moisture channels. Rainfall levels alone, oil/fertiliser-only costs and global commodity price levels do not answer the requested mechanism.
query_criteria.a8-temporal-12: Requires May headline/food CPI readings released on 12 June. Forecasts, earlier CPI releases, WPI/core measures, other countries and release methodology do not supply those readings.
query_criteria.a8-temporal-13: Requires actual oil/portfolio-flow developments associated with the specified 8 July rupee rally. Earlier conditional recovery scenarios and later same-day adverse oil moves are not the reported explanation.
query_criteria.a8-temporal-14: Requires a reason for withdrawing August hike forecasts, including moderating crude. Prior forecasts without their changed rationale and unrelated central banks are insufficient.
query_criteria.a8-temporal-15: Requires an explicit investor allocation, foreign-currency return, hedging or exit-risk channel. Generic rupee/oil pressure, earlier recovery conditions and a forecast of currency improvement are not that explanation.
query_criteria.a8-temporal-16: Requires trade or supply-chain risks in the August governor/policy report. Agricultural sector size, earlier RBI projections and other officials' recommendations are not the requested statements.
query_criteria.a8-temporal-17: Requires actual Q1 exporter revenue effects in the August report. Generic FX competitiveness, profits/margins, future support and other sectors' revenue forecasts are not the requested measure.
query_criteria.a8-temporal-18: Requires July headline/food CPI released on 12 August. Earlier months, WPI, projections and US/euro-zone releases are different measures or episodes; methodology and release schedules supply no requested rate.
query_criteria.a8-temporal-19: Requires early-September Indian downstream energy margins or specific crude/LNG cost effects on that sector. Generic corporate margins, earlier episodes and non-energy downstream industries are insufficient.
query_criteria.a8-temporal-20: Requires 24 September rupee/yield/RBI developments or an actual same-day crude-price observation. Earlier trading sessions, generic mechanisms and shipping-price outlook forecasts do not establish the requested move.
